# Kea

> Kea is a hands-free conversational companion. People pick up language naturally by talking with her — not by taking a course.

Kea is not a learning platform, tutor, chatbot, or lesson app. She talks with you like a friend. As you chat, she remembers topics and notices words you struggle with. Those words live on a Learn List until you start using them well.

Site: https://kea.chat

## For people

- Talk: https://kea.chat/conversation
- Learn List: https://kea.chat/learn
- Topics: https://kea.chat/topics

## Languages

English, Spanish, French, German, and Russian. You speak one and talk with Kea in another.
